name: german_credit_interactions
title: German credit data with pairwise interactions (300 predictors)
description: UCI Statlog German credit (german.data-numeric), 1000 customers. 24 standardized main effects followed by all 276 pairwise products (j < k, itertools.combinations order) of the standardized main effects, re-standardized to mean 0 / variance 1. No squared terms. y = 1 good, 0 bad. As used in Hoffman & Gelman (2014), Sec. 4.1.3.
